acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass tells the story of what happened at the Prairieland Detention Center in Alvarado, Texas. The government claims this was an attack by an Antifa cell. The defense says it was a protest gone awry. This argument goes to court in a first-of-its-kind trial.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Reporter Zoe Chace walks us through one of the worst days for the defense: all these guns.

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Zoe takes us through the testimony of the government’s Antifa expert. The defense team is optimistic that things are going well for them.

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Zoe goes to jail to talk with one of the cooperating witnesses for the prosecution, a former church lady named Lynette Sharp. She has a lot to say about the events in her life that led her to accept a plea deal and testify against her friends.
